_comment: BubbleShooter screenshot capture. 500-level CAMPAIGN (valid loadLevel indices 0-499, display level = idx+1). Every slot is a gameplay board at a distinct level and theme: window._bsShot(idx,theme,shots,{bank,fire}) applies Bubble Shooter's real board palette (window._BS_THEMES) + midnight chrome, loads the level with its verified first-attempt queue, plays `shots` real greedy-bot shots (bsBotPick, the same bot the content gate uses) without ever taking the winning shot, then shows the dotted aim line on the best shot (a wall bank shot with {bank:true}) or the Fireball's best burn line ({fire:true}). Promo cards (event intro) are removed during capture so no slot carries an overlay. Phone ships 7, tablets 2 each.
_readiness_expr: typeof save !== 'undefined' && typeof loadLevel === 'function' && typeof showScreen === 'function' && typeof PIPE_COLORS !== 'undefined' && !!window._BS_THEMES && typeof bsBotPick === 'function'
